parameters.note: Lake Louise is a small high-elevation lake above Homewood (Ellis Peak / Blackwood area, Placer Co.) in the Madden Creek headwaters, within the Lake Tahoe basin. Madden Creek is a Lake Tahoe tributary, but the special Lake Tahoe tributary closure (§7.50(b)(152)(A)) reaches flowing tributaries only 'upstream to the first lake' — it does not extend into the lake itself. Lake Louise is not listed by name in §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation §5.85(a)(1): open all year, 5/10.

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)
